findings.detail: Initial test assumed damped kinetic and radial speed must be smaller at the last instant. This is false for oscillatory motion. Kept all final values and added a per-step time-average comparison. Mean kinetic falls to 0.0831 of control in this case; final kinetic is 1.4602 of control. No equilibrium or post-release stability claim.

Exact zero COM-relative energy is inappropriate after mass-weighted floating-point averaging of a uniform 5000 m/s boost. Replaced exact-zero test with relative bound 1e-24 of boost kinetic energy; zero velocities before boost still require exact zero.
Added missing relaxationSeconds CommandPayload type; final ArkTS build passed.

Separate stationary basalt bodies only; fixed 0.0625-second step and linearly tapered damping 0.5/s. Residual velocities cleared and fracture reset as preparation operations. Requested spin and collision velocity added afterwards. No layered or hydrostatic planet, conserved preparation energy, convergence study or reaggregation.
